voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: South Africa, July nineteen-oh-nine. The Waratah, a big new liner, left Durban for Cape Town. She never arrived.
Two hundred and eleven people were aboard. None was ever seen again.
Early the next morning, another steamer exchanged lamp signals with her. It was the last confirmed sighting.
One passenger left the ship at Durban. He later cabled his wife that he had thought her top-heavy.
For decades, searchers combed that coast. One promising wreck turned out to be another ship. The Waratah has never been found.
